    else:
        # both directions... just use _interp_limit
        preserve_nans = set(_interp_limit(invalid, limit, limit))

    # if limit_area is set, add either mid or outside indices
    # to preserve_nans GH #16284
    if limit_area == "inside":
        # preserve NaNs on the outside
        preserve_nans |= start_nans | end_nans
    elif limit_area == "outside":
        # preserve NaNs on the inside
        preserve_nans |= mid_nans

    # sort preserve_nans and covert to list
    preserve_nans = sorted(preserve_nans)

    # sort the x and y values
    x_sorted, y_sorted = zip(*sorted(zip(xvalues, yvalues)))
    x_sorted = np.array(x_sorted)
    y_sorted = np.array(y_sorted)
    
    inds = x_sorted
    
    if method in ["linear", "time", "index", "values"]:
        result = y_sorted.copy()
        result[isna(y_sorted)] = np.interp(inds[isna(y_sorted)], inds[~isna(y_sorted)], y_sorted[~isna(y_sorted)])
    else:

    if len(preserve_nans) > 0:
        preserve_nans_in_result = [inds.tolist().index(x) for x in xvalues if inds.tolist().index(x) in preserve_nans]
        result[preserve_nans_in_result] = np.nan
        
    return result
